locations.label: South Labs power switch
locations.description: Open Main Offices, ride the elevator down to the War Room, clear access to its lower elevator and descend to the laboratories. Turn on power in the South Laboratories room behind the Soda perk machine. Gather the three shield pieces while opening the floors, then build the Riot Shield at Weapon Testing if you plan to attempt round 150. Gun assembly: Central Filing near filing cabinets; teller/Side Passage window; left of Main Offices entrance. Base: lower War Room by Server Room doorway/computers; under stairs; behind the Mystery Box position. Window: South Laboratories left of power; left of the teleporter near Weapon Testing; North Laboratories beside the barrier near Auger. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.

locations.label: Four DEFCON switches
locations.description: Collect the Teleporter Signal Amplifier’s pad from Main Offices and its wires from Morgue. For the third part, raise DEFCON to 5 by flipping four switches: two on the upper War Room balcony, one on the lower floor near the lab elevator, and one in Server Room. Before the amplifier is installed, the central War Room teleporter takes you to Panic Room; collect the amplifier there. Pad: beneath desk near Offices teleporter; on fallen desk near Mystery Box; beside Brew machine. Wires: chair near Morgue Mystery Box; countertop corner; open body chamber. There are four switches total. Normal Pack-a-Punch access accepts any order; the Kino clue later requires a particular order. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.

locations.label: War Room teleporter
locations.description: Craft the amplifier at an available workbench and place it on the small teleporter base in the lower War Room. Set DEFCON 5 again, then use the large central teleporter to travel to Groom Lake for Pack-a-Punch. After installation, the Server Room teleporter is the route back to Panic Room when DEFCON is 5. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.

locations.label: Four-code submission machine
locations.description: At the lower War Room code machine, shoot the individual digits to match a recorded code, then press the button on the right. Submit in this order: Shi No Numa → Der Riese → Shangri-La → Kino der Toten. A green acceptance light confirms each. If an entry is wrong, restart the submission sequence from Shi No Numa; your collected clues remain useful. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.

locations.label: Winter’s Howl reward case
locations.description: With Skadi retrieved, set DEFCON 5 and go to Groom Lake. Keep every player there for three full rounds; count rounds that begin and end while the whole team remains there. Leaving interrupts the stay. After the debris left of Pack-a-Punch moves, collect Winter’s Howl from the glowing case. Pack-a-Punch it normally to obtain Winter’s Fury. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.
